requirements.text: Customers should be able to book appointments by selecting a service, a barber, and a time.
Barbers should be able to set their own hours and manage breaks to keep their schedules organized.
Customers should have the ability to book, cancel, or change appointments online without calling the shop.
The system should send reminders to customers about their appointments.
The solution should fit within a budget and remain simple and easy to use for everyone.
